named_premises: Model the grace operator as a linear operator on the two-dimensional basis {|+⟩, |−⟩}, with matrix entries a,b,c,d.
The definition of the grace operator gives Ĝ|+⟩ = |+⟩, so the first column of the matrix is (1,0).
The definition gives Ĝ|−⟩ = |+⟩, so the second column of the matrix is (1,0).
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: The grace operator Ĝ is idempotent: Ĝ² = Ĝ, given Ĝ|+⟩ = |+⟩ and Ĝ|−⟩ = |+⟩.

obstructions.reason: Native growth G sends 0 -> 1/2 -> 3/4. Idempotence applies to terminal legal standing/reset, not to every grace operation.
